digitization_allowances.status: heuristic raster-read allowances, not source uncertainty, confidence intervals, or author error bars

sampling.native_trace: one pixel-column median where at least two qualifying color pixels are visible
sampling.selected_report_points: nearest native pixel-column read within the +/-0.01 s time-read allowance; no interpolation or extrapolation
sampling.target_count_interval: digitized count +/-5 clipped to the plotted 0..700 physical axis; time and count read allowances are retained as separate bounds

figure11d_values: direct transcription of numeric bar labels; no error bars or class sample counts

counts are identified liquid structures, not parcels and not direct experimental measurements
